name: Arch
summary: Holiday-let management for private owners, at the level of a hotel group's homes: a white page, a quiet hairline header with Owners first and a 'Speak to us' text link, and one art-directed photograph of a view framed by the home (an arch, a balcony door, a window seat), set inside the margins like a print. Under it the owner's year is written as one sum, guests pay − our fee = to you, from the company's own last-year figures, with bedrooms and own weeks beside it and the basis on the line below. Then between guests as a ruled day beside the room, a few of the homes large with each guest's total, what it costs and the rules where your home is. Zalando Sans Expanded and Zalando Sans at 500; hydrangea blue, from Cornish hydrangeas, for the result and links only. For holiday-let and Airbnb management companies.
